result:
The human figure changes for task 40 are shipped. The ship was v32.64 (`cw-figlook`, commit `abf82a29`), from an earlier run today. The gate passed and the seed 4242 fingerprint did not move.

This run I only re-read the "after" picture of the raid fight screen. The figure, head and shadow look right and I found nothing new to fix. I changed nothing else; the only edit was a note in `tools/handoff/console/notes/40-art-player-look.md`.

What went in:
- **Figures:** a02 B, the whole figure at 1.25 about the feet, with a04 C build heights.
- **Head and cosmetics:** a01 D head at 1.2; a05 B pack 1.3, vest and pauldron plates 1.12, chest patch 1.6. Hats and hair only scale with the head.
- **Shadow and plate:** a09 B bigger darker shadow; a10 D mate plate raised with a 36x3 health bar.
- **Dial-back:** `FIG_SCALE` is the one number that sets the 1.25.

Three things are still open and need a playtest or a later run:
- I never checked whether shots visibly pass through the drawn edge of the bigger body. Hit areas are untouched.
- There is no two-window picture of the mate plate and health bar.
- Frame time at 4K with two players on screen was not measured, so there are no before and after numbers.

TASK DONE
